# Developer and command-line tokens, typed correctly in the English layout.
#
# Used by tests/dev_tokens.rs and examples/measure_token_false_positives.rs to
# count how often automatic conversion would wrongly rewrite a real command,
# tool, package or module name (audit finding F14). The test file explains how
# to re-baseline the budget.
#
# Format: one token per line, lowercase letters a-z only, at least 3 letters,
# sorted and unique. Lines that start with '#' are comments. Names that contain
# digits, dashes, dots or underscores were dropped, not split.
#
# Sources (public names only; nothing taken from private or personal software):
#   executables  basenames in /bin, /sbin, /usr/bin and /usr/sbin that an
#                installed package ships (from /var/lib/dpkg/info/*.list)
#   man pages    names of manual pages in sections 1 and 8
#   packages     names of installed Ubuntu packages (dpkg-query)
#   python       sys.stdlib_module_names of Python 3.12
#   crates       crate names found in a cargo registry cache (crates.io)
#   git          a fixed list of git and release-workflow words:
#                status commit push pull rebase checkout stash diff merge branch
#                clone fetch reset revert cherry blame bisect tag remote config
#                init grep show log amend squash origin master main develop
#                feature hotfix release
#
# Snapshot taken on 2026-10-03 on Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS. It is a fixture: it does
# not follow the distribution, so a change here is a deliberate re-baselining.
